book.name: FILEMÓN
book.title: U Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLOXEꞌ U FILEMOON U uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te u Filemón

content: Ni taqꞌ bꞌen u Pablo itzii
Ineꞌ in Pablo uvaꞌ atoꞌk in tu u kaarsa tiꞌ u Jesucristo, as tukꞌ u qitzꞌin qatzik uvaꞌ Timoteo as ni qaqꞌ bꞌen kutzii see, Filemón, tan nu kuloch qibꞌ tiꞌ talpu u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ.

As ni qaqꞌ bꞌen kutzii unpajte te u qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u Apia, tukꞌ u Arquipo uvaꞌ nu kuloch qibꞌ stukꞌ tiꞌ talpu viyol u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌan umaj sol tiꞌ tok vatz umaj chꞌaꞌo. As ni qaqꞌ bꞌen kutzii te unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ skajayil uveꞌ nimol tibꞌ tu vakabꞌaleꞌ tiꞌ inachat Tiixh.
As aꞌ u Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo ni bꞌanon uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatin sevatzaj.
Ni taqꞌ u Pablo taꞌntiixh te u Tiixh tiꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl ikꞌuꞌl u Filemón tiꞌ u Tiixh
As ni vaqꞌ taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ, tan bꞌenameen ni vulsa axh sunkꞌuꞌl tul nunnach Tiixh seeꞌ.
As ni vabꞌi yol seeꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl chit akꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesús. As xoꞌn veꞌt Aak see tukꞌ unqꞌa itenam Aakeꞌ skajayil.
As nunjaj te u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ la txakon veꞌt u kꞌujlebꞌal akꞌuꞌleꞌ tiꞌ ichee veꞌt atxumbꞌal tiꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil u Jesucristo skajayil uvaꞌ at veꞌt sukuxoꞌl.
As vaꞌl chit kutxuqꞌtxun veꞌteꞌ, tan niyakꞌin veꞌt qaanxelal, tan xoꞌn veꞌt oꞌ see. As nayakꞌinsa veꞌt taanxelal unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uveꞌ ni niman u Tiixheꞌ.
Nijaj u Pablo bꞌaꞌnil te u Filemón tiꞌ u Onésimo
As kꞌuxh yeꞌ la xoꞌv valat see kam uvaꞌ labꞌaneꞌ tan qitzꞌin qatzik veꞌt qibꞌeꞌ kꞌatz u Jesucristo,
as aal bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ la unjaj bꞌaꞌnil see tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ nu kuxoꞌni qibꞌ sukuvatzaj. As ineꞌ in Pablo, as qꞌestu veꞌt in. As il in atoꞌk in tu u kaarsa tiꞌ u Jesucristo.
As nunjaj veꞌt bꞌaꞌnil see tiꞌ u Onésimo, tan ech najeꞌ echeꞌ umaj unkꞌaol, tan in kat alon viyol u Tiixheꞌ te naj tu u kaarsa. As kat inima veꞌt naj u Tiixheꞌ.
As kꞌuxh yeꞌlik kuxh itxaꞌk vitxumbꞌal najeꞌ kat ibꞌan bꞌaxa, pet cheel, as bꞌaꞌn veꞌt itxumbꞌal najeꞌ. As la txakon veꞌt naj seeꞌ, tan il naj nitxakon veꞌt sviꞌ cheel.
As tuk unchaj bꞌen naj unpajte sakꞌatz. As labꞌan bꞌaꞌnil uvaꞌ lakꞌul naj tibꞌaꞌnil eela kuxh stukꞌ uvaꞌ in lakꞌul in.
As il in atoꞌk tzan in tu u kaarsa tiꞌ kuxh uvaꞌ nunpaxsa u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ. As aꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ la koj kaa naj sunkꞌatz tiꞌ ilochat in, eela kuxh stukꞌ uvaꞌ axh at axh sunkꞌatz tiꞌ alochat in.
As yeꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ la kuxh kaa naj sunkꞌatz. As yeꞌ la uchi uvaꞌ la untxꞌii axh stiꞌ. Pet axheꞌ la alon, asoj labꞌan bꞌaꞌnil sve.
As kamal estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ kat teesa veꞌt tibꞌ naj sakꞌatz tiꞌ uvaꞌ lakꞌul veꞌt naj unpajte. As yeꞌl unpajtoj uvaꞌ la taqꞌ kan axh naj.

As jit kuxh veꞌt umaj akꞌam naj la ibꞌaneꞌ. Pet at pal veꞌt naj tiꞌ umaj kꞌam. As xoꞌn chit veꞌt naj sve. As echat koj labꞌaneꞌ. As jit kuxh tiꞌ uvaꞌ umaj uxhchil naj as la axoꞌni naj. Pet tiꞌ uvaꞌ qitzꞌin qatzik veꞌt qibꞌ tukꞌ naj, tan kat inimal veꞌt naj u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo.
Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ tuk unjaj bꞌaꞌnil see, tan kumool qibꞌ tiꞌ ipaxsal u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ. As kꞌul veꞌt u Onésimo eela kuxh stukꞌ uvaꞌ in lakꞌul in.
Asoj kat ibꞌan naj umaj vaꞌlexh see, pet moj at itxꞌoj naj, as sve lajajkat veꞌteꞌ.

As ineꞌ in Pablo uvaꞌ ni tzꞌibꞌan bꞌen u uꞌujeꞌ taꞌn unqꞌabꞌ, as in la choon veꞌt vitxꞌoj najeꞌ. As la uch valat see uvaꞌ at atxꞌoj siinxeꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat ok axh tiꞌ u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tul kat val isuuchil see. Pet jiteꞌ ni val see uvaꞌ ech la abꞌaneꞌ.
As bꞌan bꞌaꞌnil sve, vitzꞌin vatzik. As la abꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ nunjaj see, tan tukꞌ vibꞌii u Kubꞌaaleꞌ nunjaj see uvaꞌ la achiibꞌisa u vaanxelaleꞌ.
As nuntzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u uꞌujeꞌ see, tan kꞌujleꞌl unkꞌuꞌl seeꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ la anima u yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni val see. As ootzimal veꞌt svaꞌn uvaꞌ nimaleꞌ uveꞌ tuk abꞌaneꞌ tiꞌ uveꞌ nunjaj see.
As la unjaj umaꞌt bꞌaꞌnil see uvaꞌ la abꞌan tuch umaj vatinbꞌal, tan aꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ u Tiixheꞌ la bꞌanon kam uvaꞌ nejaj sviꞌ tul nenach Tiixh sviꞌ.
Itzojpebꞌal u yol
As ni taqꞌ bꞌen u Epafras itzii see uvaꞌ unmool vibꞌ stukꞌ tu u kaarsaeꞌ tiꞌ kunimat u Jesucristo.
As ni taqꞌ bꞌen u Marcos itzii see unpajte, tukꞌ u Aristarco, tukꞌ u Demas, tukꞌ u Lucas, tan aꞌ chajnajeꞌ u lochol vetzeꞌ.
As aꞌ veꞌt vibꞌaꞌnil u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo la atin tu vetaanxelaleꞌ. Ech chit la ibꞌaneꞌ. An chiteꞌ.
